description: This file contains utility functions for splitting a string into tokens based on spaces, and storing valid tokens into a linked list.

classes.name: SplitUtils
classes.description: An object providing static utility functions for splitting strings.

methods.name: split
methods.description: Splits a string into tokens based on spaces, returning them as a linked list.

methods.name: addIfValid
methods.description: Adds a token to the list if it passes validation.

methods.name: isTokenValid
methods.description: Checks if a token is non-empty.
